scenes.summary: The path has been cut off. Kay says she can use honey waffles to get the mushrooms to help clear the way.

lines.text: The path ahead is out...
No worries, the mushrooms know another way.
The mushroom?
Lemme see ... see that pink mushroom over there?
Sturdy, transparent mycelium are hidden under its cap. Just give it a hit with a honey waffle, and it will shoot out mycelium to connect the path.

scenes.summary: You run into a group of strange-looking Landbreakers. They're mumbling to themselves, and they've got mushrooms growing out of their heads.

lines.text: Threads within threads ... we shall all become one!
Hey look, these mushrooms are talking better than before.
No worries. I've already sent word to her.
Now grab your stuff, let's go pick some "mushrooms"!
Maybe the whole anomaly is their doing!
Hmph. Watch me toss them in the pot and make them talk soon enough.
Why are there mushrooms growing on these Landbreakers' heads?

options: Landbreakers are camping nearby. We should inform Tianshi Zhuang.
Were those walking mushrooms just these guys dressed up...?

scenes.summary: After defeating the Landbreakers, you fall into an illusion but escape with the help of a mysterious girl named Kay, a Rhodes Island Operator. She tells you that giant mushrooms have appeared nearby and offers to help with honey waffles. Before you can make sense of it all, you realize Da Pan is missing.

lines.text: Alright, spill it. What is your purpose for coming here? Are there more of you?
Purpose no longer exists... Nor do the Landbreakers... Only...
...my devotees endure...
Endministrator, we've waited so long for you. And I know, you've been searching for us as well.
Come now. Take us. You need us.
Relax... We mean no harm...
Hey! Stop! Stop right there!
Whatever Endmin is thinking, don't go any further! Stop stop stop!
Ouch ... it hurts...
Whew ... that was close! You almost fell off.
Mmm. Very very important.
Enough! Back off!
Mushroom toxins don't kick in that fast. Thank goodness Kay arrived in time!
Kay?
Miss Perlica told me you were up. So I stuffed my bag and zoomed over from Rhodes Island!
You came from Rhodes Island...?
Uh-huh, uh-huh! I heard some icky stuff was happening nearby, so I came to peek.
Didn't think I'd see you here, Endmin! No matter what happens, you're always wherever the action is.
I went over to that dam and found these huge mushrooms I've never seen before. Like, eco-disaster big!
Yes! Speaking of which, I also got something super important to share with you, Endmin!
Super important?
It smells quite nice...
Eating this honey waffle will neutralize the mushroom's toxins, so you won't have to worry about hallucinations for a while! Go on, Endmin, try it!
Here, have one — no, two ... no, ten! Have lots and lots!
Slow down! One is enough for me.
Something this delicious, should be shared with everybody!
Huh? Where's Da Pan?
Mushrooms ... dam ... eco-disaster ... I see what's going on...
A bunch of people ate the mushrooms here and ended up totally out of it, trapped in hallucinations just like the Endmin was earlier.
That giant mushroom has to be behind everyone acting like this! I was just rushing back to tell everyone when I found you, Endmin!

scenes.summary: You and Kay find Da Pan trapped in a hallucination. Kay suggests waking him up with honey waffles.

lines.text: Aiyo... This ... this mushroom even knows my name...
Endmin, Uncle Pan got tricked by the mushrooms! You can't wake him up like this. Let me help you!
We just need honey waffles.
Honey waffles?
Yep! My waffles can do way more than fill your tummy.

options: Da Pan! How did you end up over there?!
Then how do we save him?

scenes.summary: Kay's honey waffle snaps Da Pan out of his hallucination. Her honey waffles, combined with Originium Arts and local mushrooms, make an antidote. You realize the giant mushroom is behind the recent anomalies. Kay tells you that some UWST crew mates are trapped in a nearby dam, so you set out to rescue them.

lines.text: Owww — ouch, ouch, ouch! Endmin...?
You're welcome!
Using Arts to throw honey waffles snaps people out of their hallucinations. If I used rocks, though ... they probably won't ever wake up again.
Wait ... I was hallucinating?
Yep! You're not alone. Lots of people got caught in it, including me.
These mushrooms are no joke, though. If they keep spreading, Wuling City will turn into Mushroom City.
Little Kay, you said many got caught in the hallucination too...?
Yeah. Lots at the dam. All woozy, and under the mushrooms' spell. They were wearing UWST uniforms.
But now that I've found Endmin and Uncle Pan, I'm not alone in this anymore!
I tried to help, but ... there were too many of them and just one of me. The mushrooms made everyone dizzy really really fast — faster than I could help!
Alright then, Little Kay, please take us there quick.
Yeah! Just getting close makes you see all kinds of tasty treats!
Everything's fake though. If I didn't have my honey waffle, those mushrooms would've made me suffer too!
Even if you don't actually eat the mushrooms...?
Honey waffle? How does that even fix hallucinations?
The mushrooms! I added them to my waffle!
You added the hallucination-causing mushrooms into the honey waffle...?
So cooking them properly gets rid of their hallucinogenic properties?
That's right! After spending so much time out in the wild, this is basic stuff.
The UWST? Oh no, they're back too?
I hope everyone's okay...
Don't worry, Uncle Pan! We made it just in time, so everyone's going to be okay!
Then the mushrooms may be spreading some kind of substance that induces hallucinations.
Whoa, you can do that with Arts? You'll have to teach me sometime.
If you combine these ingredients with Arts, it completely cancels out the harmful stuff. It works great on poisonous mushrooms!

options: She told me to throw that honey waffle at you.
But we never ate those mushrooms...

lines.text: A recording left behind by a UWST crew mate.
Looks like they've already run into those weird Landbreakers and gone inside the dam.

scenes.summary: Fiona has reported something unusual in southern Wuling. The Wuling authorities want you to investigate with a local expert. At the rendezvous point, you discover that the expert is none other than your old friend, Da Pan. After a quick greeting, you go to the abandoned dam where the anomaly was first spotted.

lines.text: So, Endmin, how have you been?
Hey, good thing I brought all my pots and pans. I'll fix you up with some proper food therapy.
And I know this road very well. Keep going, there's a big dam built by the UWST and HAS.
Yeah, that's an old memory. When the Science Station was first set up, everyone built the dam together.
I was right here, representing the Science Station and welcoming UWST friends to Wuling.
And when it came time to clear everyone out, I was here again to see them off as they left Wuling.
Even though it's been buried under the Blight Tide for years, this road still looks exactly the way I remember it.
Sure thing. I'll show you the way.
Oh, so you're the expert...
Hey, give me some credit. I did my time at HAS.
And who knows wild critters better than our cooks, right?
A little retreat to a magical realm, huh...
Endmin ... you really should look after yourself.
Yeah, everyone needs some time to recover after a big fight...
Then the Blight got worse and worse, and the dam was left behind. Not many people remember it these days.
So HAS and the UWST go way back...
Years ago, this road was covered in all kinds of weird mushrooms. I wouldn't be surprised if these recent strange events are connected to them.

options: I took a little trip somewhere magical. Feeling much better now.
I'm alright. The Æther's messing with me less than I expected.
With Nefarith defeated, there's still plenty of recovery work to do.
Just how special is this mushroom? I must go in there to see it.

lines.text: ...Landbreakers?
Just a few small fry running away...

scenes.summary: You arrive at the dam's side door, but it's shut due to a power outage. Kay suggests using the magic of her honey waffles to open it.

lines.text: I checked. The door's fine, just not enough power.
Is there a power generator around here?
Hold on, let me see.
Did that power generator turn into a mushroom? Am I hallucinating again?
That mushroom you saw ... does it look like an unlit lamp?
A little.
Those mushrooms love growing next to power devices to feed on the energy. After they've had their fill, they go dormant, just like this one.
No time for a nap! Wake it up so we can get a power boost!
So ... how do we wake up a mushroom?
Hehe ... honey waffle, duh! My honey waffle is full of yummy power!
Little Kay ... food gives us energy, sure. But it isn't the kind that will power this door. I mean, your honey waffle's great, but I doubt it can...
Let her try. It sounds unbelievable, but her honey waffle seems to have some real power to it...
So this is where all those weird things have been coming from?
We'll issue a notice once the experts have assessed the situation. Please return for now.
